cohort: 12,451 women age 35 or older who delivered at least 28 weeks of gestation
finding: D-dimer levels ≥5.50 mg/L and emergency cesarean section were independently associated with VTE in the puerperium of women age 35 or older.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section was independently associated with VTE in the puerperium of women age 35 or older.
